newsitem.title: USA: L.A. County okays prison facility plan in concept.
newsitem.headline: L.A. County okays prison facility plan in concept.

text.p: Los Angeles County Supervisors on Thursday approved in concept a plan that would open the giant Twin Towers Correctional facility, which was completed in 1995 but has remained closed for lack of operating funds.

To open the Twin Towers, funds would be shifted from other facilities. The plan would result in about $14 million in additional county costs in 1996-1997. The net county cost in fiscal year 1997-1998 would be about $16 million.
Earlier on Thursday, the Board of Supervisors approved $90.6 million in cuts in a bid to balance the county's fiscal year 1996-1997 budget.
